summary: The note is a short biographical entry on Jeff Evans, a writer on beer. It states he was born in 1960 in South Wales, studied languages at the University of Reading, and has written professionally about beer since the 1980s. It also notes he became editor of CAMRA's Good Beer Guide in 1990 and was responsible for eight editions from 1991 to 1998.
one_line: Jeff Evans is a Welsh-born beer writer who edited CAMRA's Good Beer Guide for eight editions in the 1990s.
key_facts: Jeff Evans was born in 1960 in South Wales.
Jeff Evans studied languages at the University of Reading.
Jeff Evans has been writing professionally about beer since the 1980s.
Jeff Evans became editor of the Campaign for Real Ale (CAMRA)'s "Good Beer Guide" in 1990.
Jeff Evans was responsible for eight editions of the Good Beer Guide.
The eight editions of the Good Beer Guide for which Jeff Evans was responsible span 1991–1998.
